$comment: Brief 27 (Answers 1, 3): stopping criteria for lossrun tune (docs/operations/tuning-loop.md §5-6, docs/operations/playbook.md). Data, never code. Targets are the acceptance table's (docs/poc-plan/closeout/acceptance-table.md), on the lower bound of the 95 % interval: a stratum is an input type, with native PDFs split into recurring and first-seen templates. measure 'prefill' scores the reviewer's pre-fill (fax: review by design). Strata with fewer than minStratumDocuments documents are reported as insufficient and do not block.
$batchBudgetComment: Brief 31 item 4 (brief 30 Answers 4): the per-batch spend cap (batchBudgetUsd in the playbook) is derived in code, never typed here: replayUsdPerDocument × batchDocuments + learnUsdPerFormat × ceil(expectedNewFormatsShare × batchDocuments). Source docs/poc-plan/tco.md §3: a 12-page replay is 12 × $0.0063 ≈ $0.075; a learn on a 12-page document $0.10–0.30 (the upper end, a tuning set is chosen to be diverse); one new format per 200 documents in production, rounded up to 10 % for a tuning set. batchDocuments is the released tuning set (100 files, docs/operations/blind-run.md §3). 0.075 × 100 + 0.30 × 10 = $10.50. --budget / BUDGET still override per batch.
nonConvergence: From the second batch on: grammar changes in batch n at or above batch n-1 (and above zero) stop the loop; fall back to the delta path for that carrier class (tuning-loop.md §6). Grammar = the prompt, the schemas, the rule catalog and the lint files; FormatLearner.cs counts only in commits labelled tier-2.
